buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quality and Fabric Specifications: All bedding and linen items supplied must strictly conform to the material, GSM (Grams per Square Meter), thread count, and dimensions specified in the BOQ/Bid documen t. The fabric must be of premium quality, skin-friendly, fast-colored, and free from any weaving defects or stains. Substandard or unbranded items will be outrightly rejected. 2. Shrinkage and Color Fastness: The supplied linen (bedsheets, pillow covers, towels, etc.) must be pr e-shrunk or have minimal shrinkage well within acceptable standard limits after the first wash. The fabric must be color-fast; bleeding of colors upon washing will lead to the immediate rejection of the entire lot, a nd the supplier must replace it at their own cost. 3. Stitching and Finishing: All items must have neat, durable, and uniform stitching with strong thread. There should be no loose threads, frayed edges, or uneven hems. The finishing should be of high institutio nal standard suitable for frequent washing and rough use. 4. Brand and Certification (If Applicable): Bidders must supply reputed and established brands (where ver specific brands are asked for in the BOQ). The products should preferably comply with relevant Indian Standards (IS) or handloom marks (where applicable) to ensure durability and quality. 5. Packaging and Delivery: All items must be properly packed in transparent, dust-proof polythene bag s and further packed in sturdy corrugated boxes or waterproof bales to prevent any damage, moisture, or dirt during transit. The delivery must be made safely to the consignee address at no extra cost. 6. Replacement of Defective Items: Any item found torn, soiled, defective, or not meeting the required quality and size standards during physical inspection (CRAC) must be replaced by the supplier within 5 to 7 working days at their own expense. 7. Right to Cancel / Modify Quantity: The Buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity of the items to be procured at the time of placement of the contract. The buyer also reserves the right to c ancel the bid at any stage without assigning any reason. .
